description: The core domain Finding interface embeds a raw Anthropic SDK type (Anthropic.Messages.Message) directly, coupling the domain model itself to one specific AI vendor's response shape — the opposite of this codebase's actual, provider-agnostic AIProvider port design.

required_findings.justification: The domain layer is supposed to have zero dependencies on any specific vendor/provider — this codebase's real AIProvider port (src/server/review-engine/providers/provider.ts) exists specifically so the domain and orchestrator never need to know whether Anthropic, OpenAI, or a mock is behind it. Here, the domain's own Finding interface imports Anthropic's SDK type directly, so switching providers (or even upgrading the SDK's response shape) would force a change to core domain types — a real, current architectural coupling, not a hypothetical future risk.

explanation: A concrete provider-leakage case: the domain type file directly names a vendor SDK type today, not 'might need to someday' — the coupling exists in the diff as written. allowed_categories also accepts the cross-layer-import framing, since this is architecturally the same shape as importing across any other layer boundary, just with the domain layer as the victim rather than the source.
